O.outcome_detail: accuracy on 600 Chinese dental licensing examination questions

cells.quote: However, in our study, mainstream LLMs such as GPT-5 Thinking, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and OpenAI o3 performed comparably to DeepSeek-R1 in the context of the CDLE.
cells.note: The study reports no significant pairwise difference between OpenAI o3 and DeepSeek-R1, but does not report an equivalence test or adequate power for equivalence.
